title: Recovery role and WAL byte backlog
summary: Recovery role distinguishes primary and standby. On a standby, receive/replay positions measure local replay backlog, not distance from an unreachable primary. NULL positions provide insufficient evidence.
checks: Declare expected role and backlog threshold; compare independent primary evidence.
limitations: A role match alone does not prove promotion readiness or write availability.
applicability: PostgreSQL 14–18 collectors; live verified on primary 18
